# Uniswap SOR goldens (WHI-1443)

generated by the pinned GPL-3.0 SOR via tools/upstream/uni_sor; data, not code.

- `<case>.input.json` — frozen inputs (contract §7.4): tokens, ordered per-family pools,
  routing parameters, and the `(route, percent)` quote/gas table. Authored by
  `tools/upstream/uni_sor/author_inputs.py` (synthetic cases `g01…g14`, corpus-cohort
  cases `c01`/`c02`).
- `<case>.golden.json` — what `@uniswap/smart-order-router@4.31.10`
  (commit `04c7c0b4d85ac2a19a3ff53987d21f9c8f1fe647`) produced from that input: enumerated
  routes per family, the ordered quote list, the per-percent sorted groups (diagnostic),
  and the selection with rational amounts, cached quotes, `missing_amount` and
  `sum_of_quotients` (contract §7.5), plus provenance.
- `MANIFEST.json` — every case with its categories and input/golden SHA-256.

Regenerate with `tools/upstream/uni_sor/regen.sh`; check offline with
`uv run pytest tests/routing/test_sor_fixture_schema.py`. Do not edit by hand.
Contract: `docs/references/uni-sor-port-contract.md`.
